name: Garments of the Moon
summary: Garments of the Moon is an introductory rite of service for young night elf priests in Dolanaar. Assigned by priest trainer Laurna Morninglight, it tasks an initiate with tending to Sentinel Shaya, a wounded defender patrolling the woods south of the settlement. Fulfilling this duty marks an initiate's formal recognition within the Sisterhood of Elune.

sections.title: A Sacred Calling
sections.body: Within the boughs of Teldrassil, the Sisterhood of Elune tends both to the spiritual life of the kaldorei and the practical defense of their borders. When Sentinel Shaya is wounded while patrolling the dangerous wilderness south of Dolanaar, priest trainer Laurna Morninglight cannot abandon her post to render aid. Instead, she charges a newly trained initiate with proving their devotion by mending Shaya's wounds and bolstering her constitution with protective magic.

sections.title: Vestments of the Sisterhood
sections.body: Priests who restore Sentinel Shaya's vigor return to Dolanaar to receive their formal robes of office. These garments signify that the young acolyte has moved beyond mere classroom instruction to practical, lifesaving service under the moon's grace. In kaldorei society, supporting the Sentinels is not merely a military task; it is an act of communion with Elune and an essential duty to the safety of Teldrassil.

faq.q: Who offers the quest Garments of the Moon?
aliases: who gives garments of the moon
where to start garments of the moon
faq.answer: The quest is offered by Laurna Morninglight, the priest trainer residing in the northern building of Dolanaar on Teldrassil.

faq.q: Who needs help during this task?
faq.answer: Sentinel Shaya, a night elf guardian who was wounded while patrolling the wilderness, is stationed just south of Dolanaar awaiting aid.

faq.q: What magic is required to help Sentinel Shaya?
aliases: what spells to cast on shaya
how to complete garments of the moon
faq.answer: You must use healing magic to close Sentinel Shaya's wounds and cast protective wards to fortify her endurance before returning to Dolanaar.

faq.q: Can any class take this quest?
aliases: is garments of the moon priest only
garments of the moon class requirement
can druids do garments of the moon
faq.answer: No. Garments of the Moon is exclusively offered to Alliance priests as an early milestone in their spiritual training.

faq.q: What does the robe reward symbolize?
aliases: garments of the moon robe meaning
significance of garments of the moon
faq.answer: The robe awarded by Laurna Morninglight serves as a token of initiation, signifying that you have dutifully served Elune and earned a recognized place among the local priesthood.

faq.q: What is the relationship between this quest and In Favor of Elune?
faq.answer: In Favor of Elune serves as an introductory summons to visit the trainer in Dolanaar. While not strictly required to receive Garments of the Moon, it cannot be completed once Garments of the Moon is finished.

angles.text: This rite demonstrates the twin pillars of the priesthood: restoring wounded allies through restorative prayer and protecting them against future danger with divine wards.
For the kaldorei, the Sisterhood of Elune and the Sentinels have worked hand in hand for millennia to protect the forests and people from encroaching darkness.
